thesis: A local-liquidity sweep that is shallow, rapidly reclaimed, penetrates back inside the prior 60-minute range, shows immediate directional tick pressure and acceptable spread has higher probability of continuing away from the swept boundary than an unfiltered local reclaim.

structure.local_high: maximum high of previous 12 completed source-clock M5 Bid bars
structure.local_low: minimum low of previous 12 completed source-clock M5 Bid bars
structure.ATR14: Wilder ATR14 from completed source-clock M15 Bid bars
structure.clock: raw Darwinex/New-York-Close source clock; no UTC relabeling

event.SELL: Bid breaches frozen local_high then reclaims at-or-below it
event.BUY: Bid breaches frozen local_low then reclaims at-or-above it
event.cap: at most one completed QRPI event per side per source-clock hour
event.ATR_snapshot: freeze ATR available at first breach

micro_pressure.formula: directional sign imbalance of last 64 non-zero mid-price changes at confirmation mapped to [0,1]

score: 0..100 fixed weighted sum; no fitted weights

prediction.entry: first strictly positive-spread quote at-or-after reclaim+15s; BUY Ask / SELL Bid
prediction.exit: BUY observes Bid; SELL observes Ask; SL first; zero/crossed spread cannot fill

forbidden: fitting component weights to development PnL or hit rate
reusing QFAES score/results as a feature
